name: KRC burns from its pair on every transfer into the pair, so transfer and skim drains it
summary: KRC's _transfer, for any transfer into its PancakeSwap pair from a non-exempt sender, moves a share of the transferred amount out of the pair's own KRC balance to the burn address and calls sync() before crediting the transfer. The attacker bought KRC with flash-loaned USDT, then repeated transfer-to-pair and skim(), burning 929 KRC from the pair's reserve while recovering its own tokens, and sold into the shrunken reserve for 7,205 USDT.
notes: Reset: the owner's setSwap (slot 0xd) pointed the token's pair logic at the KRC/USDT pair 128 blocks after deployment; the burn path keys on it. Later owner calls only transferred ownership and locked tokens.
Loss is the pair's net USDT outflow; its 953 KRC outflow (929 burned) is valued at nothing (rule 12). No other transaction took more than 58 USDT from the pair.
